sentences.text: Alistipes finegoldii was named when a bile-resistant, pigment-producing, strictly anaerobic Gram-negative rod from human sources was placed with Bacteroides putredinis in the new genus Alistipes.
The strains behind the description came from inflamed and non-inflamed tissue samples collected during studies on the bacteriology of appendicitis in children.
A multi-cohort analysis of colorectal cancer metagenomes identified Alistipes finegoldii among seven bacteria enriched in cases across populations.
In a mouse experiment, Alistipes finegoldii attenuated chemically induced colitis, whereas three other Bacteroidales species tested enhanced it.
